items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no writing, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded cardboard boxes with no prints or markings, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A bright living room in the middle of a move: neat stacks of closed, taped plain brown cardboard moving boxes of three sizes against a white wall, a rolled rug tied with twine, a sage green armchair, a white oak floor. On top of one box, a blank clipboard with a sheet of paper showing only empty checkbox squares and plain lines, no words, and a pencil beside it. A roll of packing tape and a coffee mug on a box. Calm, organized, wide view, soft morning light from a large window.
